admin.title: Admin panel
admin.lead: Users, payments, broadcasts and an audit log, in the browser.
items: Overview KPIs, revenue, subscription and MRR charts
Users: search and filters, payments, gift or revoke a subscription, change roles
Broadcasts: compose, preview, send now or in the morning or evening slot
Marketing links: one code per placement, with the signups and payback it brought
Maintenance tasks with a dry run; applying is owner-only
An audit log of every admin action

payments.title: Payments
payments.lead: One PaymentsService over Telegram Stars and YooKassa.
items: Stars: one-time purchases and subscriptions that renew and cancel correctly, plus refunds
YooKassa: cards, the embedded widget, auto-renewal and refund webhooks
An idempotency key on every charge; webhooks re-fetch the payment instead of trusting the body
Failed renewals go past due, with a grace period and daily retries
At most one live subscription per user, enforced by the database
Purchase, renewal, cancel and failure alerts in your Telegram

bot.title: Bot & notifications
bot.lead: aiogram 3, on the same users and the same database.
items: Scheduled messages in each user's local morning or evening
Text, photos or native polls, with a delivery log for frequency caps
Users who blocked the bot are skipped, and picked up again when they're back
Retries on network errors, 5xx and short flood limits
Nightly database backups sent to the owners, plus a /backup command
A deploy announcement each time production starts

form.codeHint: Latin letters, digits and _, e.g. partner_post3. Can't be changed later.
form.paybackHint: Price and date are needed to count the 14-day payback from the publish date.

hints.start: The day the post went out. Greyed: the first sign-up, when no publish date is set.
hints.activated: Share of users who did something in the app (by default: opened the Mini App, so Mini App links sit near 100% and the number says most for bot links). Hover the number for the count.
hints.returned: Share who came back after 1 · 7 · 30 days. Only users who signed up long enough ago count; '—' means none yet. Sorts by 7 days.
hints.payers: Share of users who paid at least once.
hints.cac: What one user cost: price ÷ users.
hints.revenueD14: Revenue in the first 14 days from the date — how fast the post pays off.
hints.revenue: All revenue from the code's users, net of refunds and gifts. Stars and dollars converted to rubles at a rough rate.
hints.purchases: The part of revenue from purchases, without subscription auto-renewals. The gap to Revenue is renewals.
hints.roas: Revenue ÷ price: ×1 means the price is back. The tag: how many days it took; 'running' — not yet, within 14 days; 'not paid back' — not within 14 days.
